facts.fact: In his general policy declaration to the National Assembly on 8 September 2026 the Prime Minister committed the Government, over 2026-2034, to deploy the Dossier Patient Informatisé alongside an updated health map and the health observatory; no cost, budget line or coverage figure is given.

systems.tiers: to be deployed 2026-2034; tiers not stated

note: The plan here is a government policy declaration, not a costed sector strategy; the passage states an intention to deploy and nothing about what is in use.
